sources.entry: Z-Wave JS UI | Full-featured Z-Wave control panel and MQTT gateway

summary.one_liner: Z-Wave JS UI is a full-featured Z-Wave control panel and Z-Wave-to-MQTT gateway built on Node.js and Vue.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a web control panel for managing Z-Wave networks: adding, removing and configuring nodes, updating device firmware from manufacturer files, and managing direct group associations. It can expose Z-Wave devices to an MQTT broker in a configurable way and supports scenes triggered through MQTT APIs with timeout support. It also offers HTTPS and user authentication, a network graph showing node communication, debug logs and store file access in the UI, scheduled backups of NVM and the store directory, and Zniffer mode for traffic debugging. Diagnostics tools include a healthcheck and link quality tools. The README lists integrations with Home Assistant, Domoticz, OpenHAB, Jeedom, HomeSeer, Homebridge and ioBroker.
use_cases: control Z-Wave devices from a web browser
bridge Z-Wave devices to an MQTT broker
back up Z-Wave network data on a schedule
connect Z-Wave devices to Home Assistant or OpenHAB
notable: Z-Wave to MQTT gateway with configurable device exposure
Scheduled and pre-operation automatic NVM backups
Zniffer mode and healthcheck/link quality diagnostics
Integrations listed for several home automation platforms
caveats: README gives no installation or run instructions; documentation is only linked externally
Requires Z-Wave hardware, which the README does not detail further
